scope: Every regular file recursively under OLD, including hidden editor metadata, executable and Python bytecode caches; symlinks absent.
policy: Inventory ownership/retention audit only. No source edits, execution, online acceptance or correctness verification. Hashes preserve byte identity; declaration-level coverage does not claim every helper/body was formally reviewed. OLD/00-index.md is mutable routing metadata; its new checksum is recorded alongside the pre-audit checksum. No original algorithm/source content was edited.

findings.resolution: Root notified and adding largest histogram rectangle/maximal all-zero/all-one binary submatrix area+witness to existing DS08; no new header needed.
Algorithm collection with889lines and empty main; mapped graph symbols, not counted as test-only.
Historical completeness/complexity/overflow claims not adopted as verified evidence.
Four executables and three Python bytecode caches recorded by hash only, never run; three PDFs preserved with ProgVar/frankenstein explicitly excluded from active reference set.
Inspected body computes min-cost flow via SPFA residual shortest paths; mapped to04-Graphs/min_cost_flow, not a cut-only algorithm.
Inspected commented body is static DFS subtree flattening with a segment tree; mapped to tree_algorithms/lazysegmenttree, not dynamic forest ETT.

unreviewed_contents: Algorithm bodies are not fully audited; generated expansions, regression tests, editor metadata and binaries have narrower per-file read scopes. Full proof/correctness/feature-level implementation review remains assigned to future batches.
